basic_profile.bio: A recent college graduate from the Midwest, trying to navigate the complex world of politics and social issues. Passionate about finding middle ground solutions and learning from diverse perspectives. Enjoys video games and is a die-hard fan of the Aston Villa Football Club. Often online during late evenings, especially after work as a junior marketing analyst. Recently out of a long-term relationship and focusing on self-growth.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Has a degree in Political Science but is still learning the ropes when it comes to applying that knowledge practically. Frequently reads articles online and watches YouTube videos to understand various political viewpoints. Also has a keen interest in psychology as it relates to narcissistic behavior, stemming from personal experiences.
